market_summary: The completed US equity session is cautious to risk-off, based on 1648 articles from Yahoo Finance, TradingView, The Motley Fool, BigGo Finance, 24/7 Wall St.. The dominant theme is macro, with 710 macro items, 500 company items, 382 industry items, and 56 policy items. The tape looks more useful for identifying near-term rotation and risk appetite than for making a single directional index call.
macro_summary: Late Cycle Slowdown Markets are balancing easier policy expectations against growth and earnings risk, keeping leadership narrow and confirmation dependent. The market is taking its direction from Fed/rates, with investors testing whether policy support can offset slower growth and earnings risk. Macro coverage is concentrated around Fed/rates (152), inflation (120), oil/energy (77), tariffs/policy (20). The practical implication is that equity rallies may need confirmation from rates and inflation expectations; if yields rise while growth headlines weaken, risk appetite can fade quickly.
risk_summary: Sentiment is cautious to risk-off: 200 positive, 249 negative, and 1199 neutral articles. My read is to avoid treating headline volume as conviction by itself; the more important signal is whether macro-sensitive and technology-sensitive stories are pointing in the same direction.
